propositions: The rebar_reconciler root logger level is set to WARNING by __main__.py:606 via install_stderr_handler and never restored, leaking across tests in the same xdist worker.

caplog.at_level(logging.INFO) without a logger argument raises only the root logger level, so INFO records from rebar_reconciler.* are dropped by isEnabledFor before handlers see them, while WARNING records propagate.

The existing log containment guard in _rebar_log_propagation_guard covers only the rebar root logger, not the sibling rebar_reconciler root, leaving INFO assertions unprotected when order-dependent polluters run first.
Generalizing the guard to cover both rebar and rebar_reconciler roots via SHARED_LOGGER_NAMES tuple restores level snapshots for all shared loggers, making log assertions order-independent.
